sources.entry: MoePeek - Translation tool with text selection, OCR, clipboard, and manual input support. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/cosZone/MoePeek) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: MoePeek is a lightweight, native macOS menu bar translator that translates selected text, OCR'd screen regions, clipboard contents, or manually typed input.
summary.what_it_does: MoePeek runs as a menu bar app on macOS and offers five translation modes: Smart Translation (selection, then clipboard snapshot, then manual input), Select & Translate in a floating panel, OCR screenshot translation of a screen region, clipboard translation, and manual input. It supports many translation backends, including free services (Google Translate, Bing, Youdao), API services (DeepL, Baidu, Caiyun, DeepLX, NiuTrans), LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Requesty, Zhipu GLM, and local Ollama or LM Studio), and Apple Translation on macOS 15+. It detects languages across 14 languages and can read translations aloud with Apple's speech synthesis. Text is grabbed through the Accessibility API, AppleScript, or clipboard fallback. Integrations are provided for OpenClip and PopClip via extension files in the releases.
use_cases: translate selected text in any macOS app
translate text from a screenshot with OCR
translate clipboard contents on a Mac
translate with a local LLM via Ollama or LM Studio
translate text from PopClip or OpenClip
how_to_run: Download the latest .dmg or .zip from GitHub Releases
Launch the app and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions in onboarding
Optionally install the PopClip or OpenClip extension from the release assets
notable: Apple Translation runs fully on-device on macOS 15+
3-tier text grabbing: Accessibility API, AppleScript, then clipboard fallback
Non-activating floating panels that do not steal focus
Supports both traditional translation APIs and LLM backends including local Ollama and LM Studio
caveats: The app is not notarized, so macOS Gatekeeper may require removing the quarantine attribute
The author describes it as a personal, AI vibe-coded side project not designed as a polished production tool
Requires Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions for full functionality
Apple Translation requires macOS 15 or later
